scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pi-gui/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/website run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm check:workspaces && pnpm build:shared && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:extension-examples
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:baseline
scripts.test:guards: node --test scripts/ci-guards.test.mjs scripts/check-renderer-boundary.test.mjs scripts/check-workspace-typechecks.test.mjs scripts/format-guard.test.mjs scripts/check-ci-results.test.mjs scripts/typed-lint.test.mjs scripts/test-entrypoints.test.mjs scripts/marketing-assets.test.mjs scripts/state-owner-boundary.test.mjs scripts/check-contract-authority.test.mjs scripts/contract-resolution.test.mjs scripts/check-host-boundary.test.mjs .github/scripts/summarize-playwright-trend.test.mjs scripts/check-timeline-owner.test.mjs scripts/workflow-action-policy.test.mjs
scripts.test:baseline: pnpm test:guards && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/catalogs test && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/pi-sdk-driver test && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/extension-ui test && pnpm test:extension-examples && pnpm test:release-helpers && pnpm test:desktop-unit
scripts.check:architecture: node scripts/check-renderer-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-contract-authority.mjs && node scripts/check-host-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-timeline-owner.mjs
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @pi-gui/session-driver build && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/catalogs build && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/extension-ui build && pnpm --filter @pi-gui/pi-sdk-driver build
scripts.typecheck:extension-examples: pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/pr-review typecheck && pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/test-runs typecheck
scripts.test:extension-examples: pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/pr-review test && pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/test-runs test && pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/pr-review build:check && pnpm --dir examples/desktop-extensions/test-runs build:check
